narrative.details:
There was a brief battle between a few of the necromancers just around the hill, and I used that to take a closer look inside.

adventurer, not all of our recent losses were defectors. There are Gelkis being held captive further in the valley! I was not able to investigate their situation because a hulking Magram brute started charging my direction. I consider myself fortunate he lost interest quickly.

You must go back into the Valley of Bones and free them. The Gelkis stand together.
narrative.objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis clan, and rescue 5 Gelkis Captives within the Valley of Bones. Return to Nerlokh near the entrance when you are done.
